label.en: The notice seen by the empire that destroys or occupies the Engine

label.zh: 按帝国类型的第一项项目
label.en: First project by empire type

note.zh: 灵能、机械、虚境铸就机械、蜂巢与一般帝国各进行对应版本；后续三项同理。
note.en: Psionic, machine, Shroud-Forged machine, hive and ordinary empires each run their own version; the next three projects work the same way.

label.zh: 宣告者：共同体或帝国
label.en: Declared by the Community or the Imperium

note.zh: 有银河监管人或普通共同体时由共同体宣告；存在银河帝皇时由帝国宣告。
note.en: The Community declares it (Custodian or ordinary Community); with a Galactic Emperor the Imperium does.

label.zh: 首颗恒星被吞噬：他国通报
label.en: First star destroyed: notices to others

note.zh: 按收件方对该星系的情报与其是否也能建造吞星者，三选一。
note.en: One of three, by the recipient's intel on the system and whether it can build Star-Eaters itself.

label.zh: 引擎被毁：三种视角
label.en: Engine destroyed: three points of view

note.zh: 建造者（6101）、摧毁者（6102）与其他玩家（6103）各收到一种。
note.en: The builder (6101), the destroyer (6102) and other players (6103) each receive one.

label.zh: 胜利：始与终
label.en: Victory: A Beginning and an End

note.zh: 以太相引擎完工，帝国获胜；1天后其他玩家收到“末日”（6051），所有恒星系被摧毁。
note.en: The Aetherophasic Engine is complete and the empire wins; a day later other players receive The End Times (6051) and every star system is destroyed.

crisis.6050.evidence: events/nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt:611-701 crisis.6050 option fires crisis.6052 days=1: crisis.6051 to others, destroy_star_system on every system, win = yes

label.zh: 挫败：引擎被毁
label.en: Setback: the Engine destroyed

note.zh: 引擎化为废墟；废墟可以重建，故事并未在脚本上终结。
note.en: The Engine becomes a ruin; the ruin can be rebuilt, so the script does not end the story here.

crisis.6101.evidence: events/nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt:755-805 spawns crisis_sphere_ruined; 1541-1549 a ruined sphere can be upgraded again

notes.zh: “宣告危机”是星海共同体的决议，也可被投票用于任何嗜杀帝国；星海天罚与巨兽之怒到达第五级时会被强制通过。
notes.en: Declare Crisis is a Galactic Community resolution that can also be voted against any homicidal empire; reaching level 5 of Galactic Nemesis or Behemoth Fury forces it through.

notes.zh: 第一阶段完工时，拥有灵能物种或同样建造引擎的其他玩家收到“灵能警报”（6010）；第二阶段时其余玩家收到“全面警报”（6015）。
notes.en: At stage 1, other players with a psionic species or their own Engine receive Psionic Alert (6010); at stage 2 the remaining players receive the general alert (6015).

scope.zh: 完整核对 nemesis_crisis_events.txt 与 nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt 全部可见事件、五个天灾等级、特殊项目、以太相引擎各阶段、宣告/废止危机决议与吞星事件。
scope.en: Checked every visible event in nemesis_crisis_events.txt and nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt, the five crisis levels, special projects, Engine stages, Declare/Repeal Crisis resolutions and star-eating notices.

uncertain: crisis.4100/4105 also fire when the Community votes Declare Crisis against any homicidal empire or for the Great Khan (common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:11983-11989); they are placed under level 5 here, where the path forces them.
Engine stage build times are the megastructure base (3600 days per stage); modifiers were not modelled.
